# T-3: Register independent review evidence

<!-- Auto-generated by `senti spec render` from spec.json.tasks[]. Do not edit manually. -->

## Goal
Add the target-guarded flow set review-evidence boundary for finalized spec-local audit documents.

## Acceptance Criteria
- The registry exposes flow set review-evidence --file with normal target guards and bounded help text.
- The command validates path containment, regular-file status, size, schema, provenance, phase/task, current tree SHA, disposition/finding consistency, target guards, and revision before mutation.
- A valid document uses the canonical convergence transition without provider invocation; duplicate, stale, foreign, malformed, and oversized documents fail deterministically with unchanged state.

## Implementation Notes
Keep the boundary thin: parsing and Envelope mapping belong in the command; evidence validation, canonicalization, persistence, and transition belong in the shared module.

## Test Strategy
Spec-local CLI tests cover valid registration, every boundary rejection, duplicate idempotency, and tree-change revalidation.
